name: ghostpaw-email
description: Email tools with a local SQLite cache and IMAP/SMTP account configuration.
long_description: Read, search and manage email with a local SQLite cache. Configure network accounts using email account add.

db_path.title: Database path
db_path.description: Path to the local SQLite database.

tools.name: mail_read
tools.description: Read mailbox state: folder list, message queue, thread view, single message body, attachment metadata, or raw EML export.

tools.name: mail_search
tools.description: Search for messages locally via FTS or remotely via IMAP SEARCH. Returns matching message references.

tools.name: mail_compose
tools.description: Compose and send email: send new message, reply, forward, save/update/send a draft.

tools.name: mail_organize
tools.description: Organize messages: mark read/unread/starred/answered, copy, move, archive, trash, junk, label, or manage folders.

tools.name: mail_sync
tools.description: Manage the IMAP connection lifecycle and sync local state: connect, disconnect, reconnect, sync folders, or refresh the folder list.
